## DOMINICA — profile (page 150)

- **Header facts:** Region: Latin America & the Caribbean; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: Blend; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 66 thousand; GNI: 705.4; Unit line: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 678.6, **+20.6% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Start value (2015): **492.3**; end value (2025): **678.6**. The line declines from 2015 to a trough around **≈2019**, then rises through **≈2022**, eases slightly in **≈2023–24**, and reaches its **peak in 2025**.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 678.6
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed (PPG):** 484.5
    - **Short-term:** 176.4
    - **Private nonguaranteed (PNG):** 17.7
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** 484.5
    - **Multilateral:** 426.5
    - **Bilateral:** 26.3
    - **Private creditors:** 31.7
  - **Multilateral:** 426.5
    - **World Bank-IDA:** 266.5
    - **Caribbean Dev. Bank:** 112.3
    - **Other multilateral:** 47.7
  - **Bilateral:** 26.3
    - **China:** 14.5
    - **France:** 6.5
    - **Other bilateral:** 5.4

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**
  - **External debt / exports:** **308%**, **+26.5%**. Trend: rises overall, with volatility; peaks around **≈2020–21**, dips, then ends higher in 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** **96%**, **+14.9%**. Trend: broadly stable to slightly rising, with a dip around **≈2020** and a stronger rise by 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** **19%**, **-34.7%**. Trend: volatile; rises to peaks around **≈2020** and **≈2023**, then falls sharply to 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** **6%**, **-40.7%**. Trend: fluctuates at low levels, spikes around **≈2023**, then declines markedly to 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **29 yrs**; Grace period **6 yrs**; Interest rate **2.2%**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **7 yrs**; Grace period **3 yrs**; Interest rate **6.5%**

- **Notes:** Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries.
- **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
